summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Integra Resources Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, announcing the appointment of Ausenco as lead engineering partner for detailed engineering at the DeLamar Project and the launch of the NEPA public scoping period. The filing is a routine operational update on project development milestones, not a special situation. No M&A, activist, restructuring, or other event-driven corporate action is disclosed. The terms discussed (engineering timeline, NEPA process, anticipated EIS/ROD in H2 2027) are project-development updates without any financial transaction or shareholder event.
